subject: Gold Skulltula #097
text: Plant a Magic Bean near the Desert Colossus as Young Link, then return as Adult Link and ride the plant to a large rock where Gold Skulltula #097 is located at night.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #097: [ ] ... How to get: Plant a Magic Bean onto the plot of dirt by the Desert Collosus as Young Link, then return as Adult Link. Ride the plant until you come across a large rock with this Skulltula on it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #098
text: In the rightmost first-floor room with boulders and Silver Rupees, play the Song of Time near the blue block to find Gold Skulltula #098 hiding behind it.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #098: [ ] ... How to get: In the rightmost room of the first floor, the one with boulders and Silver Rupees, play the Song of Time near the blue block to move it. The Gold Skulltula is hiding behind it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #099
text: In the giant statue room, climb the west staircase, play the Scarecrow's Song, and Longshot over to reach Gold Skulltula #099.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #099: [ ] ... How to get: In the giant statue room, climb up the west staircase, play the Scarecrow's Song, and Longshot to him. This Skulltula is here.

subject: Gold Skulltula #100
text: At Zora's Fountain at night, lift the white boulder on the far right ledge using the Silver Gauntlets and enter the cave tunnel to find Gold Skulltula #100.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #100: [ ] ... How to get: At the ledge far to the right of the entrance is a dry ledge with a white boulder. Lift it with the Gauntlets and drop down the cave to enter a tunnel. Inside is this Skulltula.

subject: Advanced Spin Attack
text: At Death Mountain Trail's summit, bomb the discolored wall to find the Great Fairy of Power, who grants the magic meter and the Advanced Spin Attack.

evidence.quote:
Located at: Death Mountain Trail's summit. Bomb the discolored wall here to
 unveil the entrance to this Great Fairy's Fountain.

Ability given: Advanced Spin Attack...She also gives you the magic meter so you can
 use the Great Fairies' powers, among other magic-consuming items.

subject: Din's Fire
text: At Hyrule Castle Grounds, bomb the boulder in the corner past the gate to access a crawlspace leading to the Great Fairy of Magic who bestows Din's Fire.

evidence.quote:
Located at: Hyrule Castle Grounds. Pass the gate, then bomb the boulder in the
 corner to reveal a crawlspace leading to this Great Fairy Fountain.

Ability given: Din's Fire

subject: Farore's Wind
text: On an island behind Lord Jabu Jabu in Zora's Fountain, bomb the wall near the white rock to reach the Great Fairy who gives Farore's Wind.

evidence.quote:
Located at: Zora's Fountain. There's an island behind Lord Jabu Jabu. Plant a
 bomb near the white rock to blow open the whole wall, revealing this Great 
 Fairy Fountain.

Ability given: Farore's Wind

subject: Magic Meter Upgrade
text: Inside Death Mountain Crater from the Goron City entrance, turn right and destroy the rocks with the Megaton Hammer to find the Great Fairy who doubles your magic capacity.

evidence.quote:
Located at: Death Mountain Crater. After getting the Megaton Hammer, enter
 Death Mountain Crater using the Goron City entrance. Turn right, and break the
 rocks with the hammer to reveal the entrance to this Great Fairy Fountain.

Ability given: Isn't an ability, per se, but is actually a magic meter upgrade.

Details: A magic meter upgrade. It doubles your magic capacity, so you can use
 more magic powers at one time.

subject: Nayru's Love
text: At Desert Colossus, bomb the cracked wall between two palm trees to reach the Great Fairy Fountain containing Nayru's Love.

evidence.quote:
Located at: Desert Colossus. Find the cracked wall between two palm trees and
 bomb the wall to reveal the entrance to this fountain.

Ability given: Nayru's Love

subject: Defense Upgrade
text: Outside Ganon's Castle, lift the massive black stone with the Golden Gauntlets to enter the Great Fairy of Courage's fountain, which doubles your defense and outlines your hearts in white.

evidence.quote:
Located at: Ganon's Castle. After getting the Golden Gauntlets in the castle,
 head to its grounds and lift the massive black stone out of the way.

Ability given: Isn't an ability, rather, it doubles your defense.

Details: Doubles your defense. Now you can take twice the punishment you used
 to. This also outlines your hearts with white.

subject: Zelda's Lullaby
text: Impa teaches Zelda's Lullaby after speaking to Princess Zelda for the first time, played as Left C, Up C, Right C, Left C, Up C, Right C.

evidence.quote:
When to get: After speaking to Princess Zelda for the first time, Impa teaches
 you this.

How to play: Left C, Up C, Right C, Left C, Up C, Right C

subject: Epona's Song
text: Malon teaches Epona's Song (Up C, Left C, Right C, Up C, Left C, Right C) after talking to her three times at Lon Lon Ranch and equipping the Ocarina in front of her.

evidence.quote:
When to get: After visiting Princess Zelda, head into Lon Lon Ranch and talk to
 Malon three times. Equip the Ocarina in front of her (after she says something
 about singing a song together) and she'll teach you this song.

How to play: Up C, Left C, Right C, Up C, Left C, Right C

subject: Saria's Song
text: Saria teaches Saria's Song (Down C, Right C, Left C, Down C, Right C, Left C) at the end of the maze in Sacred Forest Meadow.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Wolfos to unlock the gate, then head through the evil Deku 
 Scrub-infested maze to the end. Go up some stairs, and talk to Saria and 
 she'll teach you her song.

How to play: Down C, Right C, Left C, Down C, Right C, Left C

subject: Sun's Song
text: Play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce mark before the Royal Tomb in Kakariko Graveyard and proceed past the Keese and Redeads to learn the Sun's Song (Right C, Down C, Up C, Right C, Down C, Up C).

evidence.quote:
Stand on the Triforce mark on the ground in front of it, and play Zelda's 
 Lullaby to open the grave. Head down, kill the Keese, head through the door, 
 pass the Redeads, head through the next opening, and read the inscription on 
 the wall...Follow the notes and 
 you'll learn the Sun's Song.

How to play: Right C, Down C, Up C, Right C, Down C, Up C

subject: Song of Time
text: After gathering all three Spiritual Stones, retrieve the Ocarina of Time from the Hyrule Castle moat to telepathically learn the Song of Time (Right C, A, Down C, Right C, A, Down C).

evidence.quote:
After the scene is over, head into the moat to grab the 
 Ocarina, at which point Zelda will telepathically teach you this song.

How to play: Right C, A, Down C, Right C, A, Down C

subject: Song of Storms
text: Playing your Ocarina in front of the windmill man in Kakariko Village as Adult Link teaches the Song of Storms (A, Down C, Up C, A, Down C, Up C).

evidence.quote:
Visit the windmill man in Kakariko Village as Adult Link and he'll
 tell you about the time a young boy with an Ocarina came in and messed up his
 windmill by playing a song. Take out the Ocarina and he'll play that song that
 angers him so. Follow the notes and you'll have learned this song!
How to play: A, Down C, Up C, A, Down C, Up C

subject: Scarecrow's Song
text: Play any custom 8 notes to the scarecrow at Lake Hylia as Young Link, then play the same 8 notes as Adult Link to enable the Scarecrow's Song.

evidence.quote:
Simply play any 8 notes you wish in front of the scarecrow at the
 shore of Lake Hylia, then return as Adult Link and play those same 8 notes and
 the scarecrow will allow you to use this song.

subject: Minuet of Forest
text: Sheik teaches the Minuet of Forest (A, Up C, Left C, Right C, Left C, Right C) upon arriving at the Forest Temple entrance in Sacred Forest Meadow as Adult Link.

evidence.quote:
When to get: Reach the entrance to the Forest Temple in the Sacred Forest
 Meadow as Adult Link, and Shiek will appear to teach you this song.

How to play: A, Up C, Left C, Right C, Left C, Right C

subject: Prelude of Light
text: After completing the Forest Temple, return to the Temple of Time where Sheik teaches the Prelude of Light (Up C, Right C, Up C, Right C, Left C, Up C).

evidence.quote:
When to get: After clearing the Forest Temple, return to the Temple of Time and
 Shiek will appear to teach you this song, along with allowing you to return to
 the past at your will.

How to play: Up C, Right C, Up C, Right C, Left C, Up C

subject: Goron Tunic
text: Detonating a bomb as the rolling Goron child rolls over it stops him, and talking to him rewards Link with the heat-resistant Goron Tunic.

evidence.quote:
Plant a bomb in such a way so that it'll
explode right when the small Goron child rolls over it, stopping him. Ask him
about the dragon and what happened to the Goron race, and he'll give you the
Goron Tunic, allowing you to survive in intense heat.

subject: Bolero of Fire
text: After crossing the bridge inside Death Mountain Crater with the Hookshot, Sheik stops Link and teaches the Bolero of Fire (Down C, A, Down C, A, Right C, Down C, Right C, Down C).

evidence.quote:
Use the Hookshot to cross the bridge,
and Sheik will stop you, and teach you this song.

How to play: Down C, A, Down C, A, Right C, Down C, Right C, Down C

subject: Serenade of Water
text: Obtaining the Iron Boots in the Ice Cavern causes Sheik to appear and teach the Serenade of Water (A, Down C, Right C, Right C, Left C).

evidence.quote:
When to get: Grab the Iron Boots in the Ice Cavern. Sheik will then teach you
this.

How to play: A, Down C, Right C, Right C, Left C

subject: Nocturne of Shadow
text: After clearing the Water Temple, visit Kakariko Village to trigger a cutscene after which Sheik teaches the Nocturne of Shadow (Left C, Right C, Right C, A, Left C, Right C, Down C).

evidence.quote:
When to get: Simply after clearing the Water Temple, visit Kakariko Village and
watch the cinema. After it's over, Sheik will teach you this song.

How to play: Left C, Right C, Right C, A, Left C, Right C, Down C

subject: Requiem of Spirit
text: Entering and exiting the Spirit Temple at the Desert Colossus prompts Sheik to teach the Requiem of Spirit (A, Down C, A, Right C, Down C, A).

evidence.quote:
When to get: Simply enter the Spirit Temple inside the Desert Colossus then
exit, and Sheik will teach you this.

How to play: A, Down C, A, Right C, Down C, A
